title: Pokemon Emerald Ported to WebAssembly (100k FPS)
summary: Pokemon Emerald, a Game Boy Advance game, has been ported to WebAssembly, achieving approximately 100k FPS in the browser without requiring any plugins or native installation.
problem_solved: Enables classic GBA games to run natively in web browsers with near-native performance.
why_valuable: Demonstrates WebAssembly's capability to run performance-intensive applications like game emulators in browsers, making retro gaming universally accessible without installation.
